scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run prisma:generate && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.build:vercel: npm run prisma:generate && npm run build -w frontend -- --outDir ../public --emptyOutDir
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
